shortDescription: Beijing-based artificial intelligence company Z.AI Co Ltd HKEX:2513 raised a total of $5 billion from a Hong Kong share placement of about $2 billion and a concurrent convertible bond sale of about $3 billion, the company said in a Hong Kong stock exchange filing on Sunday.
